description: Election Commission - Declare that D. Pushparani was elected as the member of the Udapalatha Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Udapalatha Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, which is a process governed by the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with electoral procedures for local government, including the nomination and declaration of a new member by a political party, falling under the category of electoral processes and related matters.
